title: Order the Asset Lifecycle
prompt: Put the steps of an asset's lifecycle in the correct chronological order, from defining the need to end-of-life.

items.label: Planning / scoping: define the need, criticality, and security requirements
Acquisition / procurement: include encryption, support, and compliance in the specifications
Assignment / accounting: assign the owner and record the asset in the inventory
Monitoring / asset tracking: track patches, movements, and compliance in production
Disposal / decommissioning: sanitize or destroy data, revoke access, and certify end-of-life

explain: Correct order: s1 -> s2 -> s3 -> s4 -> s5. Plan before purchasing, assign an owner before operating, track continuously, and finish with documented disposal. Skipping a step creates an unprotected shadow asset.
